definitions.context: One exact config × symbol × direction; zero-trade contexts remain in the denominator.
definitions.lastNReady: At least the full configured Last-N closes strictly before each clock. The separate full-window minTrades and all PF/DDT/DDR/stability gates still apply.
definitions.qualifiedHistory: Only exact contexts passing all config gates at this clock. Overlapping configurations are not independent market observations; this PF is not later execution PF.
definitions.execution: Funded settled modeled closes after all execution gates, verified against exact source tapes; endpoint marks excluded.
definitions.protection: Effective percent protections after lane scaling/floors/caps. ATR multiples and floors are separate from resolved per-entry prices.
definitions.ddt: Context history DDT uses unit-return running peaks; account equity DDT includes minute open-position marks and is separately reported.

ledger.scope: Funded modeled parent orders; actual venue partial fills are verified separately in native control fixtures.

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close

caps.source: balance-volume defaults (no balance caps in the settings)

entrySelection.scope: Settled tape candidates only; own config validation is not complete admission. Ranking, shared guards, funding and endpoint-open candidates are separate.
